description: This file defines the 'User' class, which extends 'Person' and implements 'EmailInterface'. It includes properties representing user data fields, methods for user management such as retrieve, save, password validation, authentication, preferences handling, and related entity retrieval. It also manages user permissions, export, email counts, and other user-related functionalities within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user entity within SuiteCRM, providing properties and methods for user data management, authentication, preferences, role checks, related object retrieval, and other user-specific functionalities.
